versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive documentation covering Hologres privilege management using the PostgreSQL standard (Expert) authorization model.
- Included quick start guides for user creation, privilege grants, and diagnostics.
- Detailed instructions for managing schema, table, column, and view privileges.
- Explained default privileges setup for future objects.
- Added common error troubleshooting, best practice recommendations, and reference links for further diagnostics and advanced scenarios.
